verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts evaluate pre-defined rules against issues and automatically take actions such as sending notifications, creating tickets, calling webhooks, or invoking integrations. The docs give a concrete trigger example (notify Slack when a new issue is created), and Seer Autofix adds automatic scanning and triage of incoming issues. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule conditions, filters and action configuration, any evidence of defining rules programmatically via API/MCP for AI-native workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
Send a notification to your team's Slack channel when a **new** issue is created.
Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
